'''JUMP UP''' is the second ending theme for the Korean dub of ''[[Pokémon Journeys: The Series]]''. It debuted in [[JN061]], replacing [[Memorizing Pokémon Names]]. Unlike previous Korean ending themes, it uses various episode clips from ''Pokémon Journeys: The Series'', containing no footage from its corresponding Japanese ending theme, [[Pokémon Shiritori]]. 

The song was [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hDEdeZIP9mY uploaded] to the official Korean Pokémon YouTube channel on October 14, 2021.

==Ending animation==
===Synopsis===
{{Ash}} hurries out of home having overslept, and then runs along the path alongside {{AP|Pikachu}}. The scene changes to [[Goh]] who then brings out {{TP|Goh|Scorbunny}} from its {{i|Poké Ball}}. Scorbunny and Goh perform a high five. The scene jumps to Ash in a battle with Pikachu using {{m|Thunderbolt}}, while Goh orders Scorbunny to use {{m|Ember}}. {{TP|Goh|Heracross}} then uses {{m|Megahorn}} on {{TRT}}, blasting them off into the sky. This scene is followed by Ash and Goh flying on {{p|Lugia}}'s back.

Brief cutscenes are then shown which include Ash, {{AP|Riolu}}, [[Bea]], {{TP|Goh|Raboot}}, {{TP|Goh|Magikarp|giant Magikarp}}, {{an|Leon}}, and {{p|Charizard}}, and [[Chloe]] and {{TP|Chloe|Eevee}}. Pikachu, {{AP|Lucario}} and {{TP|Goh|Cinderace}} perform a high five. The final scene is of Ash, Goh and Pikachu posing before this transitions to the Pokémon W series logo.
